title: [Epic] Label-based access control and purpose restriction (Markings): classification labels on objects and records that travel with the data, enforced at every read door, purpose-scoped grants, enterprise governance console
body:
coordinator#1 · os-warren · session_01JQwxbaUTJVFuEz81NDUrnw

Filing gate: ④ coordination parent, on the maintainer's ruling. The maintainer, in the project's Fable decision thread "Discuss Palantir direction (objectstack#31763)", 2026-11-09T03:32Z, verbatim: 「Palantir 的核心能力我们都应该要有，不等客户需求」 — on the thread's analysis that label-based mandatory access control (Palantir Markings) and purpose-based access are a Palantir layer the platform does not have. Ruling-ref: 6731568115 (the #31763 ruling this amends: label governance is no longer "on customer pull"). Then, 2026-11-09T03:39Z–2026-11-09T03:41Z, on the open/paid split, the maintainer asked that the governance floor be weighed 「从商业策略的角度」 and ruled with the thread: this layer is **entirely Enterprise** (label enforcement, purpose restriction, console), following the `hierarchySecurity` precedent (cloud `docs/design/ee-feature-catalog.md`: the open framework declares the scopes, unlicensed they are fail-closed; the resolver is the license-gated `SecurityEnterprisePlugin` in cloud `packages/security-enterprise`). The open edition carries only the label **vocabulary** in the spec, and **refuses loudly** when a label is present and no enforcer is mounted — never a silent no-op (ADR-0049). ⛔ Not a claim. ⛔ Security boundary: every child that widens or narrows what a principal can read is the human floor — analysed and recommended by seats, ruled by the maintainer, never self-ruled (pm-dispatch red lines; `references/security-findings.md` for anything found on the way).

Epic parent under the #31502 A′ working mode: `tracking` + `area:access`, no pm state label, never dispatched; decisions anchor in the children. Filing lane and table owner: `domain:spec` for the vocabulary and the refusal contract in this repository; the enforcer, purpose engine and console are **cloud-repository** cards (`packages/security-enterprise`, `apps/objectos-ee`), tracked here by link only. Ordered **after** #31763 on the roadmap: labels must travel with synced rows, so the provenance columns land first.

## 维护者速读

Palantir 的 Markings 与 Purposes：给数据打「机密 / 个人信息 / 某项目」这类标签，标签随数据走（同步、派生、导出都带着），没有对应授权的人在任何入口都读不到；再加「用途限制」，同一份数据只允许在声明的用途下访问。我们今天有 RBAC / RLS / FLS / 共享和姿态梯子（ADR-0066、0095、0099），但没有标签这一维。开源 / 收费（维护者裁定，2026-11-09T03:39Z–2026-11-09T03:41Z，沿 `hierarchySecurity` 先例）：**整体企业版**——标签执行、用途限制、治理控制台都在企业版。开源版只拿到规范里的标签词汇（协议能校验、能序列化），并且遇到标签时**响亮拒绝**「此部署需要企业版才能执行标签」（ADR-0049：不能静默忽略，不能当作无标签放行）。这是企业版面向 Palantir 替代场景的核心付费点。排在 #31763 之后。

## Milestones and children

| Milestone | Child | Blocked-by | Lane |
|:--|:--|:--|:--|
| **M0 — design decision** | (filed when #31763 P1's ADR is accepted) [Decision] where labels live (object-level declaration, record-level column, both), how they compose with the posture ladder (ADR-0095 / 0099: labels can only narrow), how a label travels on sync (#31763 provenance), derived writes (lineage epic) and export; the open edition's refusal shape when no enforcer is mounted; the `markings` feature flag in the EE catalog | #31763 P1 | spec · fable + xhigh |
| **M1 — ADR** | (filed after M0's ruling) the vocabulary and the enforcer seam: label declaration, grant-to-label, the read-door injection point at the sharing / RLS seam (the open framework exposes the seam, fail-closed like the `unit_and_below` scopes), the loud refusal, the audit row; a cloud ADR for the enterprise enforcer mirrors it | M0 | spec · Tier H |
| **M2 — seam + refusal (open)** | this repository: the label vocabulary in the spec, the enforcer seam at every read door (REST, ObjectQL, analytics datasets, search, MCP, export) through the one seam ADR-0099 D3 uses for the EXTERNAL rung, and the loud refusal when a label is declared and no enforcer is mounted; `os validate` reports the same | M1 | server |
| **M2′ — enforcer (enterprise)** | cloud: `SecurityEnterprisePlugin`-style label enforcer mounted under a `markings` entitlement, injected at the M2 seam; EE catalog row | M2 | cloud |
| **M3 — purpose restriction (enterprise)** | cloud: purpose-scoped grants — a grant names the purpose, a session declares one, the explain surface reports it; approval of a purpose through the approval engine (ADR-0019) | M2′ | cloud |
| **M4 — governance console (enterprise)** | cloud: label inventory, who-can-see-what by label, purpose approvals and reports, SIEM export of label events (cloud#3665) | M2′ | cloud |

Rolling split: nothing is a card until #31763's P1 ADR is accepted; this parent holds the table.

## Done-when

On the open edition, declaring a label on an object makes `os validate` and the boot say loudly that label enforcement requires Enterprise, and no read door treats the labelled rows as unlabelled; on Enterprise, a record labelled `confidential:finance` synced from a warehouse is invisible to a member without that label grant at every door (list, search, report, MCP, export) and the refusal is loud; the label survives a flow that derives a new record from it; a purpose-scoped grant lets the same member read it only in a session that declares the approved purpose; the enterprise console lists every label and its readers.

## Non-goals

Replacing RBAC / RLS / FLS (labels compose with them and can only narrow); natural-language rules; document-content classification (a knowledge-adapter concern).

## Related

#31763 (sync-in epic, prerequisite), the sibling lineage epic (filed on the same ruling, linked from #31763), ADR-0049, ADR-0066, ADR-0095, ADR-0099 (the EXTERNAL rung's injection seam is the precedent for a label seam), ADR-0057 / `hierarchySecurity` (the open-versus-enterprise precedent), cloud#767 (AI governance), cloud ROADMAP.md. Analysis: the project's Fable thread "Discuss Palantir direction (objectstack#31763)".
